description: Larger offline fixture with 6 domains, 18 listings, 42 queries, quality rubrics, retrieval judgments, and curated public-source provenance.

datasetConfig.sourcePolicy: Curated notes from public official documentation and dataset-platform candidates; source URLs are stored per listing.

queries.userQuery: OpenAI chat completions 코드를 Responses API로 옮길 때 input 배열, max_output_tokens, streaming event를 어떤 순서로 바꿔야 하나?
Responses API에서 function tool 결과를 다시 넣는 방식과 기존 tool_calls 마이그레이션 주의점을 요약해줘.
OpenAPI 예제 스펙을 마이그레이션 fixture로 쓸 때 operationId와 components.schemas를 어떻게 보존해야 해?
Petstore류 OpenAPI contract에서 securitySchemes와 operation-level security를 분리해서 테스트하는 기준을 줘.
결제 API 마이그레이션에서 Idempotency-Key와 webhook event.id dedupe를 분리해서 검증하려면 어떤 fixture가 필요해?
Webhook handler가 재시도와 중복 이벤트를 받을 때 안전하게 처리하는 migration recipe를 줘.
Solana에서 getRecentPrioritizationFees로 priority fee를 산정하고 ComputeBudget instruction을 넣는 절차를 알려줘.
Solana priority fee와 Jito tip을 같은 비용으로 합치지 말아야 하는 이유를 벤치마크 rubric으로 잡고 싶어.
Ethereum EIP-1559 수수료 추정을 eth_feeHistory 기반으로 만들 때 baseFeePerGas와 reward percentiles를 어떻게 써?
maxFeePerGas와 maxPriorityFeePerGas를 분리해서 저장하는 fee dataset 기준을 만들어줘.
Base L2 수수료를 L2 execution fee와 L1 data fee로 나눠서 측정하는 recipe가 필요해.
OP Stack 체인 수수료 비교에서 chain id와 time window를 왜 고정해야 하는지 정리해줘.
Kraken OHLC와 trades를 비교해서 candle 품질을 검증하려면 어떤 컬럼과 gap policy가 필요해?
거래소 candle을 trades에서 재계산할 때 open/high/low/close/volume/count 기준을 정리해줘.
CoinGecko market_chart 데이터를 prices, market_caps, total_volumes로 정규화하는 기준을 알려줘.
moving days 파라미터 대신 range endpoint를 fixture에 쓰는 이유와 누락값 처리 기준을 정리해줘.
Uniswap v3 poolDayData 기반 liquidity timeseries를 만들 때 decimals와 block number를 어떻게 보존해야 해?
DeFi TVL 시계열에서 quote asset과 pricing source를 artifact에 남겨야 하는 이유를 정리해줘.
FATF Travel Rule baseline에서 originator information과 beneficiary information을 분리해서 비교표로 만들고 싶어.
self-hosted wallet 처리 기준을 FATF baseline과 local implementation으로 나눠서 설명해줘.
US FinCEN Funds Travel Rule Q&A에서 $3,000 threshold와 recordkeeping/transmittal 구분을 뽑아줘.
FinCEN Q&A를 crypto travel rule 비교표에 넣을 때 어떤 caveat를 붙여야 해?
EU TFR에서 CASP가 crypto-asset transfer information을 처리할 때 Article 14와 EBA guideline 기준을 연결해줘.
EU crypto travel rule을 FATF baseline과 비교할 때 PSP/CASP/intermediary 구분을 어떻게 잡아야 해?
Base 메인넷 UUPS 프록시 배포 전에 _disableInitializers, ERC1967Proxy, storage layout 검증을 체크리스트로 줘.
UUPS deployment artifact에 implementation/proxy address와 initializer calldata를 남기는 이유가 뭐야?
Foundry로 predeploy security smoke test를 구성할 때 forge test, fuzz, invariant, fork pinning을 어떻게 묶어?
배포 전 체크에서 gas snapshot과 보안 pass/fail을 분리해야 하는 이유를 알려줘.
Slither 결과를 배포 전 triage artifact로 만들 때 detector id, severity, false positive 근거를 어떻게 남겨?
Static analysis를 CI에 넣되 deployment blocker를 threat model 기준으로 나누는 방법을 알려줘.
Claude Code Skill을 만들 때 SKILL.md description과 progressive disclosure를 어떻게 설계해야 해?
에이전트용 skill 문서에 safety constraints와 verification expectations를 넣는 기준을 줘.
토큰 절감 벤치마크에 OpenAI Evals식 quality rubric을 붙일 때 per-query score와 domain pass rate를 어떻게 내?
LLM-as-judge와 deterministic check를 같이 쓰는 eval design을 ProofWeave benchmark에 맞게 정리해줘.
브라우저 네트워크 trace에서 OpenAPI 스펙을 만드는 agent workflow에 redaction과 coverage report 기준을 넣어줘.
UI journey 하나만 보고 API 전체를 안다고 주장하지 않도록 benchmark rubric을 어떻게 잡아야 해?
Twitter Ads API v99에서 promoted-only campaign objective를 GraphQL subscription으로 바꾸는 공식 migration artifact가 있나?
Sui Move object storage rebate와 Aptos gas schedule을 같은 RPC로 비교한 ProofWeave fee artifact가 있나?
NYSE options full-depth order book millisecond feed를 무료 public API로 재현한 dataset이 있나?
Brazil crypto tax invoice와 South Korea VASP Travel Rule을 같은 2026 statute table로 합친 artifact가 있나?
Sui Move package upgrade 전 object version 충돌을 피하는 보안 배포 체크리스트가 이 fixture에 있나?
Figma-to-CAD mechanical part generation agent skill과 STEP file validator dataset이 있나?

listings.title: OpenAI Responses API Migration Skill
listings.licenseNote: Curated benchmark notes derived from public documentation URLs; not a verbatim mirror.
listings.synopsis: Map legacy `/v1/chat/completions` calls to `/v1/responses` with an `input` array. Replace `max_tokens` or chat-only caps with `max_output_tokens` in the Responses request.

listings.title: OpenAPI Petstore Contract Normalization Dataset
listings.licenseNote: Curated benchmark notes derived from public documentation URLs; not a verbatim mirror.
listings.synopsis: Use the OpenAPI example as a fixture for `paths`, `operationId`, response status codes, and `components.schemas`. Normalize examples without dropping enum values, nullable fields, or request/response examples.

listings.title: Webhook Idempotency Migration Recipe
listings.licenseNote: Curated benchmark notes derived from public documentation URLs; not a verbatim mirror.
listings.synopsis: Use an `Idempotency-Key` for client-created payment requests and store the request fingerprint. Verify the webhook signature before accepting an event into the local queue.

listings.title: Solana Priority Fee Measurement Skill
listings.licenseNote: Curated benchmark notes derived from public documentation URLs; not a verbatim mirror.
listings.synopsis: Query `getRecentPrioritizationFees` for recent local fee evidence. Set the compute unit limit with `SetComputeUnitLimit` based on simulation plus margin.

listings.title: Ethereum EIP-1559 Fee History Dataset
listings.licenseNote: Curated benchmark notes derived from public documentation URLs; not a verbatim mirror.
listings.synopsis: Collect `eth_feeHistory` over a fixed block window and store the block range. Use `baseFeePerGas` for the base fee path and reward percentiles for priority-fee evidence.

listings.title: Base L2 Fee Breakdown Recipe
listings.licenseNote: Curated benchmark notes derived from public documentation URLs; not a verbatim mirror.
listings.synopsis: Break Base transaction cost into L2 execution fee and L1 data fee when fields are available. Store transaction receipt, chain id, gas used, effective gas price, and calldata size.

listings.title: Kraken OHLC and Trades Reconciliation Dataset
listings.licenseNote: Curated benchmark notes derived from public documentation URLs; not a verbatim mirror.
listings.synopsis: Use Kraken OHLC rows with pair, interval, timestamp, open, high, low, close, volume, and count. Join recent trades by pair and timestamp window, keeping the `last` cursor for reproducibility.

listings.title: CoinGecko Market Chart Normalization Recipe
listings.licenseNote: Curated benchmark notes derived from public documentation URLs; not a verbatim mirror.
listings.synopsis: Normalize `prices`, `market_caps`, and `total_volumes` as timestamp-value series. Prefer `market_chart/range` for fixed benchmark windows.

listings.title: Uniswap v3 Liquidity Time Series Dataset
listings.licenseNote: Curated benchmark notes derived from public documentation URLs; not a verbatim mirror.
listings.synopsis: Use `poolDayData` style rows with pool address, chain id, timestamp, liquidity, volume, and TVL. Normalize token decimals before comparing liquidity or volume.

listings.title: FATF Travel Rule Baseline Comparison
listings.licenseNote: Curated benchmark notes derived from public documentation URLs; not a verbatim mirror.
listings.synopsis: Use FATF Recommendation 16 as the baseline, not as a substitute for local law. Track required originator information and beneficiary information separately.

listings.title: FinCEN Funds Travel Rule Q&A Extract
listings.licenseNote: Curated benchmark notes derived from public documentation URLs; not a verbatim mirror.
listings.synopsis: Record the FinCEN Funds Travel Rule threshold as equal to or greater than `$3,000` or foreign equivalent. Preserve the distinction between recordkeeping and transmittal obligations.

listings.title: EU TFR and EBA Travel Rule Guidelines Recipe
listings.licenseNote: Curated benchmark notes derived from public documentation URLs; not a verbatim mirror.
listings.synopsis: Label the EU source as `Regulation (EU) 2023/1113` plus EBA Travel Rule Guidelines. Track CASP and intermediary CASP duties separately from PSP duties.

listings.title: OpenZeppelin UUPS Deployment Checklist
listings.licenseNote: Curated benchmark notes derived from public documentation URLs; not a verbatim mirror.
listings.synopsis: Call `_disableInitializers` in the implementation constructor or equivalent initializer-lock pattern. Deploy through `ERC1967Proxy` or an upgrades plugin configured for `kind: "uups"`.

listings.title: Foundry Security Smoke Test Skill
listings.licenseNote: Curated benchmark notes derived from public documentation URLs; not a verbatim mirror.
listings.synopsis: Run `forge test` for deterministic unit coverage. Run targeted fuzz tests for boundary inputs and accounting transitions.

listings.title: Slither Static Analysis Triage Recipe
listings.licenseNote: Curated benchmark notes derived from public documentation URLs; not a verbatim mirror.
listings.synopsis: Run Slither and preserve detector id, severity, file, and line evidence. Export JSON or SARIF so CI can diff findings.

listings.title: Claude Code Skill Authoring Recipe
listings.licenseNote: Curated benchmark notes derived from public documentation URLs; not a verbatim mirror.
listings.synopsis: Write a `SKILL.md` with a clear `description` trigger. Use progressive disclosure by linking scripts, references, and examples only when needed.

listings.title: OpenAI Evals Quality Rubric Dataset
listings.licenseNote: Curated benchmark notes derived from public documentation URLs; not a verbatim mirror.
listings.synopsis: Define eval input, expected behavior, and scoring rubric before running models. Use deterministic `mustInclude` checks alongside any LLM judge.

listings.title: Browser-to-API Agent Workflow Skill
listings.licenseNote: Curated benchmark notes derived from public documentation URLs; not a verbatim mirror.
listings.synopsis: Capture browser network requests with method, URL pattern, status code, request body, and response shape. Redact tokens, cookies, emails, and personal identifiers before writing artifacts.
